messages:
elaine: Hey folks — kickoff for the NorthCloud HW + SI joint listing. Marketplace needs SOC2 attest, pen-test summary, completed supplier questionnaire, and an artifacts manifest. Timeline: partner wants listing live in ~2 weeks. Who can take each piece?
omar_s: I can own security artifacts (SOC2 PDF + pentest summary + attestations). Quick note: we should avoid sharing raw exploit logs until NDA is in place. Also need assurance about KMS/HSM material — confirm nothing private is in the bundle.
viv_k: I'll coordinate with the SI and HW PMs. Can someone confirm presign window for uploads and any redaction guidance we require? I'll also collect contact info for the portal.
alex_p: For presigns, ops usually does 72 hours for partner uploads, but for review we sometimes extend to 7 days if reviewer list is long. For artifact structure please use a manifest with checksums and a minimal schema. Suggest naming conv and a manifest column 'contains_secrets: yes/no'.
marcus: I can take upload + presign ops. I'll schedule a 30-min vendor walkthrough (Wed 10am PT) to show the portal and required fields. Marcus -> will handle the portal contact + upload once artifacts are redacted.
omar_s: Redaction guidance: we want a short executive pentest summary (1 page) + vulnerability scorecard, and the raw report should be redacted for customer PII/keys. If pentest > 12 months old we need a scoped attestation or a re-scan. Also require a simple attestation line: "We confirm no production secrets included."
viv_k: @omar_s noted. I'll ask SI to provide redacted logs + a summary JSON for the checklist and the attestation statement. Will also ask for the SOC2 date and control scope.
alex_p: Quick filename regex to standardize uploads (easier to validate):
```
^([a-z0-9-]+)_(\d{8})_(soc2|pentest|questionnaire|arch)_v\d+\.zip$
```
Manifest should be CSV with: filename, sha256, size_bytes, artifact_type, contains_secrets (yes/no), owner_email.
marketplace-bot: Reminder: marketplace portal requires a single "compliance_contact" field and one point of contact email. Portal docs: https://redwood/internal/marketplace/compliance-guidelines (internal).
elaine: OK — proposed owners: Omar -> security artifacts & attestation, Viv -> partner coordination & questionnaire, Alex -> manifest schema & validation script, Marcus -> upload/presign + scheduling. I'll draft an artifact checklist by EOD and tag owners.
omar_s: Also adding: for hardware partners include firmware SBOM if available, and note any third-party components. If SBOM not available, mark as NA in manifest.
viv_k: Noted. I'll ask PM to surface SBOM and CI provenance.
marcus: Scheduling note: I'll create calendar invite for Wed 10am PT and add the SI, HW PM, Omar, Alex, and Elaine. If that time conflicts, say so in thread.
elaine: One last ask — who will do the final redaction verification? We need a single person to sign off before upload.
omar_s: Security will do final redaction check but partner needs to submit both redacted and an internal raw copy under NDA if requested by legal.
viv_k: :thumbsup: I will chase the SI for items and update the checklist as responses come in.
elaine: Great — thanks everyone. I'll post the checklist link here when ready.
marketplace-bot: Note: retention policy for review artifacts is 90 days by default, unless legal requests longer retention.
elaine: Heard. We'll keep eng/ops in the loop if retention needs to be extended.
viv_k: pinging SI now, will report back here with expected delivery dates.
marcus: Invite sent (Wed 10am PT).
elaine: Thanks — wrapping. Please post any blockers in this thread so we can escalate.
